author: Mod Ash
quote:
The item sink is blocked from spending more coins than the tax has sunk, for obvious reasons.
But not all the sunk coins are put towards sinking items. The item sinks are told how many of each item to try sinking per day/week, and they'll spend however much that takes, up to the spending limit I described. In practice, I think that leaves a LOT of the taxed coins unspent, so those coins just vanish from the economy. Probably well over half the taxed coins are drained in that way rather than being re-injected by sinking items.

author: Mod Ash
quote:
The accuracy roll is performed for the NPC you targeted. If you splash off it, you'll splash off the whole group. If you succeed in the accuracy roll, you've succeeded for the whole group. Hence the tactic for attacking a bodyguard who's standing next to a boss, so that the accuracy roll will be easier than if you attacked the boss directly.
A max hit is calculated for the NPC you targeted, taking into account Salves and Avarice. You roll damage for the targeted NPC up to that max hit.
A (potentially) different max hit is calculated for all the other NPCs in the group, disregarding boosts from Salves and Avarice. You do an individual damage roll for each other NPC in the group, up to this max value.

I believe the Salve exception was written into the design because of concern that it'd be OP if it could buff the max hit against the whole group.

author: Mod Ash
quote:
Port Sarim door

Without a lockpick:
First time you try, chance is 0% at level 1, 39% at level 99.
As you repeat, your chance increases to 82% at level 1, 127% at level 99.
With a lockpick:
First time you try, chance is 23% at level 1, 117% at level 99.
As you repeat, your chance increases to 106% at level 1, 206% at level 99.

HAM hideout

Without a lockpick:
First time you try, chance is 4% at level 1, 99% at level 99.
As you repeat, your chance increases to 27% at level 1, 123% at level 99.
With a lockpick:
First time you try, chance is 24% at level 1, 118% at level 99.
As you repeat, your chance increases to 47% at level 1, 141% at level 99.

(Any figure of 100% or above means you're guaranteed to succeed; the number is only relevant for calculating the chances at other levels between 1 and 99.)

author: Mod Ash
quote:
If you're guaranteed to succeed on an earlier try, no, you won't get to the later try because you'll have succeeded already and passed through the door, and your state would have reset next time you visit.
Restarting the 'Pick-lock' option would reset your state, I believe.
The increments I described are in 4 equal steps.
